iconicAnchor.label: American carnival and circus show poster
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Commercial midway and circus lithographic poster tradition
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The complete poster shows how superlative display type, spectacular illustrated attraction, event information, and saturated print color compete in a vertical public advertisement.

sources.title: Circus poster collection item
supports: A documented complete show poster demonstrates stacked headline hierarchy, exaggerated central attraction, lithographic color, and compact logistical copy.

sources.title: Advertising and Propaganda Posters
supports: Historic poster collections establish the medium's public scale, persuasive purpose, illustrated spectacle, and relationship between image and display lettering.

bundledReferenceRationale: The complete poster is an excellent lead: bold circus/wood-type hierarchy, saturated ink color, performer imagery, ornamental framing, and venue/date blocks remain coherent and uncropped at both scales. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/carnival-poster/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
